import { Content as KotlinReadme } from "../../../../../../../sdks/kotlin/README.md";

The native Kotlin client for Android apps and JVM desktop apps: plain-JVM service modules behind
the `PolarisKeyClient` umbrella, the standalone Android `:platform` backend (the one the Godot
binding links), the `:android` glue between them, and the Compose UI kit on its own
[page](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/). Every artifact ships only from Polaris Key's Maven feed. This
page renders `sdks/kotlin/README.md` whole, so there is exactly one copy to keep current.
